Seven always/sometimes/never statements and counterexample drawings
Square always rectangle and always rhombus, inclusive trapezoid hierarchy preserved
rich2021SourceExamples: Original 2021 Grade5 U07:L07 synthesizes the hierarchy with a graphic Venn relationship and ALWAYS/SOMETIMES/NEVER claims. Square is always rectangle and rhombus, both parallelograms; inclusive trapezoid contains all parallelograms but has other members too.
Warm-up What Do You Know About This Shape? depends on original figure, requiring actual teacher inspection. No invented image attributes are promoted as the original drawing.

Activity1 Quadrilateral Clues gives seven exact card-selection requests including quadrilateral not parallelogram, rhombus square, rhombus not square, trapezoid not rectangle, rectangle not square, parallelogram not rectangle and square NOT rectangle. Last is IMPOSSIBLE; partner may use each source figure only once.

Activity2 prints seven ALWAYS/SOMETIMES/NEVER statements; rhombus sometimes square, square always rhombus, triangle never quadrilateral, square always rectangle, rectangle always parallelogram, parallelogram sometimes rhombus, trapezoid sometimes parallelogram. For SOMETIMES, pupils must actually draw both examples and counterexamples.

Source cooldown asks placement in Venn diagram and is diagram-based. Bounded selected items support property reasoning but original source diagrams, card reuse and teacher sketches still require visual validation.
limitations: Publisher original cards/coordinate diagrams not independently certified
Original teacher-gated Cool-down distinct from independently authored alternative; teacher scores shape classifications and patterns
